tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (oṃ)༄༅/ /mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len zhal shes dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru dharma bi dza ya/sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*/ /
(oṃ)༄༅/ /mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len zhal shes dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru dharma bi dza ya/sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len zhal shes dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru dharma bi dza ya/ sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*// padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan 'od 'bar ba// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams// lha mo khyod kyis bdag sogs 'gro 'di skyongs// gang gis brten na dag pa mkha' spyod du// 'khrid mdzad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// nyams len zhal shes dang bcas ma sbas par// 'bri la bla ma mkha' 'gros skabs phyes shig /'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ sa skya pa chen pos/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs pa ltar bcu gcig yod pa las/ dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bsam mi khyab gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'am/ ma bsgoms kyang rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nam gyi brgyad cha tsam nas nam mkhar dpa' bo mkha' 'gros ḍā ma ru'i sgra/ oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar grags pa'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad par bsam ste/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang*/ gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nang mchod dam bdud rtsi ril bu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas myong ste/ snying kha'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par bsam/ bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro dgos shing de'i tshul ni/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i ngang las/ gzhi yongs su dag pa'i bai ḍūrya'i sa gzhi gser zhun mas mig mangs ris su bres pa/

mnan na nem byed cing btegs na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa de'i dbus su seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru dang g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ rang gi g.yas su pha'i gtso byas pa'i pho nye/ g.yon du ma'i gtso byas pa'i mo nye/ mdun du rang nyid la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs/ mtha' bskor kun du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa sems can thams cad ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa ltar khrig mer gyis gang bar gyur/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang nyams pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po ma mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i tshe bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la sems gtad/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i tshe de'i phung po lnga rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la sems gtad/ dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i tshe de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan la sems gtad/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i tshe de'i phyi nang gi skye mched sems dpa' yab yum kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la sems gtad/

bcu gcig yan lan ci 'grub bya/ mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas sems chos sku dang*/ lus zag med bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku 'ba' zhig tu gyur te/ dag pa'i zhing khams so sor bya'i khyu 'phur ba ltar 'ur ding nge 'phur song bar gyur/ bla ma de 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ tshad med kyi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes pa 'di yin pas lan gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi bab he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka te no pa tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba sidhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa nyer gcig yan ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ nyes pa dang ltung ba/ dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas tshogs rten gyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go zhes gsung lhang gis ston nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas de spyi bo nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ bla ma bskyed bstim gyi zhal shes nyams su len pa yin la/ de'i tshul ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du mkhas mchog ngag dbang chos grags nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bla ma rnams la cha tshang ba re thim pas/ thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che'i 'khor du bdag gi gnyen 'khor thams cad 'bul lo// 'dod chags zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rnal 'byor pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad 'bul lo// zhe sdang zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bar ma'i 'gro ba longs spyod dang bcas pa 'bul lo// gti mug zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang sems rnal 'byor mar gyur pa spyi bo nas 'thon te/ rang lus tsho zhing snum pa de nyid smin mtshams nas gri gug gis reg ste thod pa kog

mdun du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du dpral ba rang la bstan te bzhag pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ de'i nang du rang gi lus dum bu dum bur byas la bskyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥgasum brjod pas/ zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du= yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du= rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa thams cad tshim zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po oṃ gyi rnam pa can byung*/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po āḥ'i rnam can byung*/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po hūm̐ gi rnam pa can byung*/ rang gi thugs kar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'bru gsum gyi rnam pa can byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gis bskor ba hūm̐/ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang sangs rgyas rdo rje chos gnyis su med pa la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas/

rtsa ba'i bla ma de'i dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar dang gdan seng khri nas yar 'od du zhu nas/ snying ga'i thad du 'od kyi phung po dmar la 'dril ba mtheb tshig tsam du gyur/ de rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying kha'i bam̐ yig la thim pas de yang je cher song ste stong gsum thams cad khyab/ mthar stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsams la/ cung zad 'dzin med du bzhag drug pa bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po rnam pa he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir 'phros pas rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa tshur 'dus rang la gnyis su med par thim/ brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i g.yon du bskor ba dang bstun/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pas thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas phyir 'phros/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ pad skor dang bcas/ 'khyud rgya byas te/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddhonyahaṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad du phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thog mar lus dkyil gyi zhal shes nyams su len dgos pa de'i tshul ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i srog la a shad 'byung bzhi'i sa bon ya ra la wa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje ma dmar mo/ byang du ljang gu/ nub tu dmar mo/ lhor ser mo/ shar du dkar mo rnams kyi mtha' bskor du/ oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnal 'byor ma nas 'bras tsam sum cu rtsa gnyis/

dbus kyi rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar mo/ de'i mthar g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ pho nya gsum gyis byin rlabs/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam pa can du spyan drangs nas thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ zhes brjod cing oṃ gsum ma brgya stong la sogs pa bzla/ yid bzlas ni rlung ro lan gsum phyir bud rjes mchil ma gcig mid pa lhan cig tu snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa lte bar byon/ rlung kha sbyar 'dzin/ yid kyis lte ba'i sngags phreng lan bdun tsam bzla/ rlung dal bus btang*/ yang rlung kha sbyar 'dzin chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ slar rlung dal bus btang*/ zhar byung rdzogs rim ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal pa'i lus gyi dbus drang por/ rtsa dbu ma dmar gsal rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ rtse mo spyi bo nas sba gug pa ltar 'khyog ste smin mtshams su ha re yod pa/ de'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po nas tsam zhig g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas de'i dbu ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyi ri ri byon/ snang ba thams cad bde cham cham song*/ snying ga'i thad du dmar khyi ri ri 'khor ba la sems gtad/ yas sner dga' ba 'khyil pa dkar po nas tsam zhig g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas de bdag gi spyi gtsug gi dbu ma'i nang du byon/ nang nas mar babs pas snang ba thams cad stong cham cham song*/ snying ka'i thad kyi dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po'i steng du byon/

reg la ma 'byar tsam du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas phrug chil gyis 'dres nas kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od kyi rang bzhin myur du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas mthar dbu ma'i stong pa dang dbyer med du yal song bar bsams la 'dzin med du bzhag bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa yin la de'i tshul ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma phra ba dmar ba drang ba gsal ba ste chos bzhi ldan yas sne spyi gtsug tu zug pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam yas sne spyi gtsug nas sba gug ltar 'khyog nas sna bug g.yas g.yon du zug pa/ gsum ka'i mas sna lte bar sleb pa/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dzom par bam̐ yig dang dbyer med pa'i rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig gsal gdab/ de la sems cher gtad pas/ chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar rnal 'byor ma chung ngu zhig nar gyis chad/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig tu me stag yar ba ltar g.yas ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug khyug song*/ sna bug gi sgor sleb pa dang*/ de las de 'dra ba grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas skad cig gcig nyid la tshur 'dus/ rnal 'byor ma chung ngu de la thim/ de nyid rlung nang du 'jug pa dang*/ sna bug g.yon pa nas g.yon rkyang ma'i nang nas mar khyug khyug byon/ rlung nang du gnas pa dang lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsams shing rlung ci thub bzung*/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu lan bdun sogs ci rigs pas lam sbyangs pa'i mthar lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros/

rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yan lag rnams 'od du zhu nas lus kyi rdza ma la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od phung dmar por gyur/ de tsam na rang sems rnal 'byor ma de mkha' spyod du 'byon par chas nas/ steng phyogs su nar tsam byon pas rtsa dbu ma dbu ma'i gtsug tu thim pas je thung du song*/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis kyi mas sne'ang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs mthil la 'byar ba gyen la 'then pas je chung la song*/ de nas rnal 'byor ma de rim bzhin snying ga dang mgrin pa'i thad du byon/ rtsa gsum kyang de tsam du 'dus/ lus 'od kyi gong bu'am smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas der thim/ rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma de spyi gtsug tu byon pa dang mnyam du rtsa gsum 'od phung dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma la sib kyis thim/ de'i rkyen gyis rnal 'byor ma de nyid kyang mkha' la me stag yar ba ltar dmar me re re byon/ dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su sleb pa dang*/ nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar gsal lam la 'dzin med du ci gnas bzhag yang nam mkha' nas rang sems rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa de nyid thol gyis byung*/ phyi lus kyang sngar bzhin grub par bsams la sngar gyi dmigs pa de nyid nyer gcig sogs skabs dang bstun la bya'o// 'di la chig dril byas na rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dag pa mkha' spyod du khrid nas lus 'ja' lus dang*/ longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam/ sangs rgyas las chos dngos su nyan/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro// 'di deng sang gi bar gser gyi maṇḍal dang bcas chig brgyud las mang ba la mi ster ba'i bka' rgya dam dog shin tu che bar mdzad pa yin no// //'pho ba'i zhal shes las/ rje btsun yum la brten pa'i 'pho ba ni/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po zangs dung kha gyen la bstan pa lta bu gcig

lte bar rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po zhig gsal gdab/ spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhig bsam/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs bla ma la thim/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ lte ba'i rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po de dpag chen mda' 'phang ba bzhin rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas song*/ spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs la thim par bsams la 'dzin med du bzhag rnam rtog 'phro na bla ma'i thugs ka nas bam̐ yig chad de lte ba dang*/ bla ma snying ga'i thad du zhugs/ tshangs bug rdo rje rgya gram dmar pos bkag par bsam pa ni 'pho ba sbyang ba yin la/ las sbyor gyi tshe bam̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar thim pas/ bla ma de je mthor song ste mkha' spyod du sleb par bsams la 'dzin med du bzhag pa yin no// 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags ni nang dri bzang gis khyab pa/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa dang*/ spyi bo za ba/ chu ser 'dzag pa sogs 'byung ba yin no// //rje btsun yab la brten pa ni/ gzhan tshang ma yum la brten pa dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bstan pa ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma bde mchog lhan skyes su bsgom/ lte bar rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb tshigs tsam zhig gsal btab/ 'pho ba sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba sogs bya'o// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/

rang dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku/ sgra grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sngags/ sems kyi dran rig thams cad rje btsun ma'i bde stong dbyer med du shes par byas nas nyams su len pa yin no// rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul zhal shes dang bcas bstan zin to// rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag nyams su len par 'dod na/ tshar pa'i khrid yig tu blta bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni tshar pa'i khrid yig bzhin nyams su len bde bar don grub dpal bzang gis bris pa'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs par gyur cig/ ༈ /

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi zin bris bzhugs so// ༈ /pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyi zhabs drung du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs gnang dus/ bshams dang*/ bdag mdun dang*/ bdag 'jug sogs tshar chen gyi byin rlabs kyi yi ge ji lta ba bzhin gnang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur dus mtshams sbyar gyi skabs/ rtsa rgyud nag po'i skor/ kun spyod lū hi pa'i/ zab don dril bu pa'i/ yang zab nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sogs dang*/ yon dbul/ gsol gdab/ mig dar/ me tog slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas khaṇḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa spros nas khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba la bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags dang bcas bum chu ku shas 'thor zhing bzhengs nas slob ma so so'i spyi bor bum chu 'thor ba gnang*/ des phyi'i bgegs thams cad bskrad/ da nang gi bar chad thams cad dag par bya ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsi ljags thog tu phul ba la brten nas mgrin pa'i ya ra la wa'i rtsa 'dab nas brgyud/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis gang nas/ nang gi bar chad thams cad thim pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ ring du 'dun pa'i dus kyang*/ de'i don gsung*/ de nas nang gi sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa spogs nas 'di'i rjes zlos oṃ sarba ta tha sogs/ de brtan pa'i phyir khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par bya ba'i thugs mos mdzod/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ sogs gsung*/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa thams cad 'di lta bu'i rje btsun ma'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la mi smra bar gdams pa yin te/ deng khyod sogs rdo rje spyi bor/ dngos su slob dpon gyi rdo rje la 'jus te khrid pa'i thugs mos mdzod la/

'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥgasung ba zhu zhing*/ re res phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje la reg pa dang bcas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsogs brjod/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ khyad par gyi sdom pa bzung dus/ thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol yan gyis gang la sdom pa bzung ba'i yul bstan cing*/ dpang por gsol ba dgongs su gsol nas/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad la sogs pa'i sdom pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis sam/ bde mchog rang nas bshad pa'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis sam/ shes rab ma la brten pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung zhes pa'i don yin gsung*/ de nas slob ma'i gzhi lus sprul pa'i dus sngags sogs kyi sbyang ba mi gsung la 'od gsal stong nyid de'i dang las zhes dang*/ gsol gdab/ sindhu ra'i rje btsun ma'i sogs dang*/ thugs ka nas de 'dra'i rje btsun ma'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re dmar rgyang rgyang chad nas khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ oṃ gsum sogs gsungs shing*/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi lus phyi nang thams cad du gar stabs ling ling du yar khyug mar khyug mdzad pa'i mthar/ lte ba'i bam̐ yig de nyid la thim pa sogs gsungs nas go cha'i lha bkod/ de nyid na lte ba'i bam̐ yig de nyid gzhi gdod ma nas rdo rje phag mor bzhugs pa de nyid/ bdag med ti la ka zhes pa/ kye rdor pas nang gi rdo rje bdag med ma'am/ bde mchog pas rdo rje phag mor gsungs pa de nyid yin gsung*/ gsang ba'i ngo sprod kyi dmigs pa sogs nas/ dhu dhu ra gu hya sa ma ya zhes pas gsang bar gdams pa yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i slob bshad pa'i lugs kyi kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'o gsung*/ phyi'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs pa'i sgo nas dbab pa sogs mdzad nas/ dang po spyi'i rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs pa'i sgo nas dbab pa/

rjes ma des rang gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal btab pa'i tshul gyis dbab pa/ gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ngo sprod pa'i tshul gyis dbab pa sogs yin no gsung*/ sku bab na sogs gsung*/ byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid mi 'bral bar brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram me tog phul/ gdong phye/ sku tshom bu/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs sindhu ra dang bcas pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gzigs byung snyam pa'i thugs mos gsung ba las/ lha ngo ston pa rgyas pa mi gsung*/ yang maṇḍal gsol btab/ rnal 'byor ma dpal gsung*/ spyi bor gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can rtse mo tshangs pa'i gnas su yer yer gnas pa/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du 'phan/ mtha' skor kun tu mchod tshogs rgya mtsho lta bus bskor te bzhugs pa sogs dang dbang lha bstim/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis khyed rang rnams khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa sogs gsung zhing me tog slob ma re re'i mgo bor 'jog par mdzad/ gzhan dkyus bzhin/ gsang dbang gi dus/ mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin khyed rang rnams kyi ljags la phul ba'i thugs mos sogs/ oṃ gsum ma bdud rtsi de nyid mgrin pa'i ya ra la wa'i rtsa 'dab nas brgyud byang sems 'di nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du sbyin pa la brten nas/ sku lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems gzhir gnas/ dam tshig pa'i tshul du dbyer med du bsres pa la brten nas rang bzhin brgyad cu sogs gsung*/ sher dbang gi dus/ mkha' nang gi byang sems de nyid rlung gi stobs kyis gyen du drangs pa la brten nas/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad me re re gang nas gsung*/ lhan skyes dang mnyam par cung zad 'jog
dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod gang rgyas sogs dkyus bzhin mdzad do// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
